summary:
Two high-speed trains collided south of Madrid near Toledo, killing 68 people, though one report gave a toll of 69. Spain began three days of mourning on Thursday. Transport minister said one train was told to continue despite a technical failure that had halted services, and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez pledged a full investigation.

In Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc had won 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset with more than 90 per cent of ballots counted, short of a majority. The opposition has 67 seats, including 48 for Gadi Eisenkot's centrist bloc and 19 for Arab-majority parties.

North Korea fired around a dozen short-range ballistic missiles off its east coast on Thursday, Seoul's defence ministry said, less than a week after South Korea proposed talks over a border row. Seoul accuses Pyongyang of causing a landmine blast that injured three of its soldiers, which North Korea denies. The European Central Bank said Christine Lagarde will step down on February 7, 2027, nearly nine months before her term expires.

headlines.title: Two high-speed trains collide in Spain, killing 68 people
headlines.summary: Two high-speed trains collided south of Madrid near Toledo, killing 68 people, though one report gave a toll of 69. Spain began three days of mourning on Thursday, and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez pledged a full investigation into the country's second major train accident this year.

headlines.title: Netanyahu's bloc falls short of majority in Israeli election
headlines.summary: With more than 90 per cent of ballots counted, Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc had won 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset. The opposition has 67 seats, including 48 for Gadi Eisenkot's centrist bloc and 19 for Arab-majority parties.

headlines.title: North Korea fires around a dozen ballistic missiles off east coast
headlines.summary: North Korea fired around a dozen short-range ballistic missiles off its east coast on Thursday, Seoul's defence ministry said. The launch came less than a week after South Korea proposed talks over a border row that began with a landmine blast Seoul says injured three of its soldiers.

headlines.title: Christine Lagarde to step down as ECB president in February 2027
headlines.summary: The European Central Bank said Thursday that Christine Lagarde will step down on February 7, 2027, nearly nine months before her term expires. Her successor will be appointed by the European Council under EU treaty rules.

headlines.title: Hong Kong housing secretary resigns after Tai Po fire report
headlines.summary: Housing Secretary Winnie Ho resigned on Wednesday after an independent committee found that the Housing Bureau's checking unit failed to supervise maintenance work at the Tai Po tower fire. The November 2025 fire killed 168 people and injured 79, and Chief Executive John Lee apologised on Thursday.

headlines.title: Defeated Brazilian candidate Flávio Bolsonaro arrives in Miami
headlines.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro arrived in Florida on Wednesday after losing Brazil's presidential election to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. He denies fleeing and claims to be the victim of a coup and political persecution, and police had cancelled his passport in an investigation.

headlines.title: Vance writes to Iranian security chief to restart peace talks
headlines.summary: Vice President JD Vance sent a letter to Iran's security chief at President Donald Trump's direction. The letter proposed an immediate resumption of comprehensive talks, including on Iran's nuclear programme.
